reference_guidelines.description: Actor classifier representing the system administrator interacting with the system; must be located outside the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: An administrator will be responsible for updating these details in the system.

reference_guidelines.description: Actor classifier representing the client interacting with the system; must be located outside the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: If the barrier does not open, the client will have to follow the instructions displayed at the parking lot entrance.

reference_guidelines.description: Actor classifier representing the gate sensor device sending data to the system; must be located outside the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: a gate sensor (GS) will be installed at the entrance of each parking lot, identifying the arrival and departure of vehicles and sending the data to the system in real-time.

reference_guidelines.description: Actor classifier representing the conveyors’ controller device interacting with the system; must be located outside the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: The Conveyors’ Controller (CC) will scan the vehicle number, assign a conveyor and ask the system to run an optimization algorithm to find the nearest vacant space to the conveyor location.

reference_guidelines.description: Actor classifier representing the external rate service interacting with the system; must be located outside the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: fixed price lists, sent yearly by the Integrated Rate Service (IRS) in a JSON format.

reference_guidelines.description: Actor classifier representing the external payment gateway interacting with the system; must be located outside the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: the system will send a request to the external Payment Gateway (PG) with the client details and the payment amount; Once the payment is approved, the payment gateway will notify the system

reference_guidelines.description: System Boundary named 'ParkWise System' must enclose only Use Case classifiers relevant to parking and club management
reference_guidelines.citation: To automate its services, the company has initiated the development of an information system that satisfies the following specification.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier for administrators to update parking lot number, name, address, and city; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: For each parking lot, the system will store a unique number, name, address, and city. An administrator will be responsible for updating these details in the system.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier to process vehicle arrival: get data from gate sensor and search database; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: When a vehicle arrives, the system will get its data (from the gate sensor) and search the database for the corresponding vehicle number.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier invoked to open the barrier when the vehicle is found; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: If the vehicle is found, the system will instruct the gate sensor to open the barrier.

reference_guidelines.fragment_name: Process Vehicle Entry – include Open Barrier
reference_guidelines.description: Include relation from 'Process Vehicle Entry' to 'Open Barrier' for mandatory barrier opening behavior
reference_guidelines.citation: If the vehicle is found, the system will instruct the gate sensor to open the barrier.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier for client to provide personal details and photos when barrier fails to open; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: These instructions guide the client to access the system and provide the required details, including first name, last name, mobile phone number, and three photos of the vehicle (front, rear, and side views).

reference_guidelines.fragment_name: Provide Vehicle Details – extend Process Vehicle Entry
reference_guidelines.description: Extend relation from 'Provide Vehicle Details' to 'Process Vehicle Entry' for optional alternative behavior when the barrier does not open
reference_guidelines.citation: If the barrier does not open, the client will have to follow the instructions displayed at the parking lot entrance.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier to automatically extract vehicle number, type, color, size, and weight from uploaded photos; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: Based on the uploaded photos, the system automatically extracts the vehicle’s details: number, type (as text), color, size (small, medium, or large), and weight (in kg).

reference_guidelines.fragment_name: Provide Vehicle Details – include Extract Vehicle Details
reference_guidelines.description: Include relation from 'Provide Vehicle Details' to 'Extract Vehicle Details' for mandatory detail extraction behavior
reference_guidelines.citation: Based on the uploaded photos, the system automatically extracts the vehicle’s details: number, type (as text), color, size (small, medium, or large), and weight (in kg).

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier to record parking session start time and vehicle details; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: After passing the barrier, the system will store the parking session information, including  start time and vehicle details.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier to assign a conveyor and run optimization algorithm to find nearest valid parking space; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: The Conveyors’ Controller (CC) will scan the vehicle number, assign a conveyor and ask the system to run an optimization algorithm to find the nearest vacant space to the conveyor location.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier to update system with final conveyor location and parking completion; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: After moving the vehicle to the designated parking space, the conveyors’ controller will update the system on parking completion and the final location of the operating conveyor.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier to send an SMS message with parking details to the client; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: An SMS message with the parking details will be sent to the client's phone.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier allowing client to view parking details via system UI using phone number; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: This data is also available through the system UI, if the client enters his or her phone number.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier for client to end parking session by entering vehicle number and phone number; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: For getting the vehicle back, the client types in the system UI the vehicle number, his or her phone number (for validation), and clicks "end parking".

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier to request client payment via system UI; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: The client will be requested to pay via the system UI.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier to calculate payment based on fixed price lists from IRS; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: The payment amount will be calculated based on fixed price lists, sent yearly by the Integrated Rate Service (IRS) in a JSON format.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier to maintain price history for each parking lot; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: The system will maintain price history for each parking lot.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier to handle notification from Payment Gateway and instruct gate sensor to open gate; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: Once the payment is approved, the payment gateway will notify the system, which will instruct the gate sensor to open the gate.

reference_guidelines.fragment_name: Process Payment – include Handle Payment Gateway Notification
reference_guidelines.description: Include relation from 'Process Payment' to 'Handle Payment Gateway Notification' for mandatory post-payment behavior
reference_guidelines.citation: Once the payment is approved, the payment gateway will notify the system, which will instruct the gate sensor to open the gate.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier to issue receipt upon client’s request showing details and final amount; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: The system will further issue a receipt at the client’s request.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier for clients to register for the free club membership; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: Clients can register to the club through the system UI at any point of time.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier for club members to select preferred parking lots with audit of selection dates; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: During registration, and at any time afterwards, the client can select preferred parking lots (the selection dates are stored for audit purposes).

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier to apply automatic discount or free session for club members; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: Club members will get an automatic, fixed discount for all parking sessions.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier for administrator to generate yearly income report in PDF and XML ordered by city and amount; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: Annual Summary Report – a yearly overview of all incomes of ParkWise. The report will include a list of all parking lots, the total amount paid (per lot), and the number of vehicles in “other” colors which parked in the lot, in a given year. The report will be ordered by parking lot’s city (descending order) and total amounts (ascending order). The report will be generated  in both PDF and  XML formats.

reference_guidelines.description: Use Case classifier for administrator to generate monthly club growth report ordered by month; must be enclosed within the System Boundary
reference_guidelines.citation: Customer Club Growth Report – a monthly overview of new and total club members. The report includes, for each month in the current year, the number of customers who joined the club in that month, the cumulative total of active members by the end of the month, and the percentage of total growth compared to the previous month. The report will be ordered by month in ascending order.
